about_the_game:
Welcome to the Datquinso Desktop Pets Demo!

Here you can see what it's like to have adorable little pals keeping you company, right on your desktop! 

Use this demo as a testbed for feeling out the pets, their behaviors, and making sure there are no compatibility issues before purchasing. Some key features are disabled.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: 2 GHz
  • Graphics: Hardware acceleration capable
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Some setups or tablets might have issues with transparency. Please try out the demo.
